gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-saira: Wide, techy and sharp-edged: Conthrax stretches its lowercase until the capitals barely stand taller. And Saira follows with rounded letters and see-through s shapes, so a long stretch of text moves along like one continuous thread.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-sarpanch: Approachable is not the first word for Conthrax, which draws every curve in one uniform stroke. Sarpanch, in a sans-serif cut, is the friendlier one, with an open e and compact proportions suited to running text, while the heading font handles display.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-savate: Savate reads light, open and surprisingly sturdy in its hairlines. Conthrax brings a pencil-flat, geometric stroke against that gentle variation, and that tension between the two is the strongest quality here.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-schibsted-grotesk: Conthrax runs wide and geometric, with tails and terminals as heavy as its stems. Schibsted Grotesk sits beside it with big open e and a shapes, so the sans-serif text feels friendlier against that rigid display face.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-sen: Conthrax stretches out wide, its lowercase so tall the capitals barely lead. And Sen, a plain sans with tall letters and constant weight, can be sized up a little so its curves stay easy to follow.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-sintony: Clean and confident, Conthrax draws every stroke with no contrast from stem to terminal. Sintony adds a chunky, tall midzone and smooth curves, and that blend of stencil rigidity with a plain sans ease is the strongest quality here.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-sofia-sans: Cut-acrylic and crisp. Conthrax is best at wide, geometric display lettering, while Sofia Sans, a sans-serif with tall lowercase and open rounded sides, is best at carrying the lines that follow.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-sofia-sans-semi-c: Conthrax goes wide and geometric, its lowercase barely shorter than its capitals. Sofia Sans Semi Condensed does the opposite job, a narrower sans with stencil-like constant strokes and generous entrances into each curve that suit running text.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-sono: Approachable and professional both describe Sono, whose tall lowercase and ajar a keep text loose. But Conthrax does the loud work, cutting its glyphs like strips of equal width, while this plain sans handles the quieter lines.
gen-dafont-conthrax-gf-stack-sans-headli: Conthrax cuts every glyph as if from strips of equal width, wide and geometric. And Stack Sans Headline, a plain sans with a monoline skeleton and deep middle band, earns its keep in big, short display lines.
